list_online_players.description: List online players. This endpoint is cached for 30 seconds in the USER cache source. See [Caching](/welcome#caching). This endpoint belongs to the PLAYER rate-limit bucket. See [Throttling and Rate Limits](/welcome#throttling-and-rate-limits). Online player list is subject to [Access Rules](/privacy), which can hide some players from the list. Rely on the field `total` to have the accurate player count.

identifier.description: Switches player descriptor between either their username or their uuid.

server.description: Filter online players to a specific world such as `WC1` or `1`.

get_player_identity.description: Who Am I. This endpoint is not cached. See [Caching](/welcome#caching). This endpoint belongs to the PLAYER rate-limit bucket. See [Throttling and Rate Limits](/welcome#throttling-and-rate-limits). Try it will not return usable data for this route. It depends on authentication and IP-aware context, so test it against the live API outside the docs. Data returned here depends on the accounts you used to join Wynncraft. Those accounts represent who we think you are and are used for account-aware features such as store auto-login and map live position viewing.

get_player.description: Get player profile. This endpoint is cached for 2 minutes in the USER cache source. See [Caching](/welcome#caching). This endpoint belongs to the PLAYER rate-limit bucket. See [Throttling and Rate Limits](/welcome#throttling-and-rate-limits). Player stats are subject to [Access Rules](/privacy), which can hide some of the stats. Check the `restrictions` object to see which access rules affected the response. It is recommended to request players by UUID. Username lookups can return `300 MultipleObjectsReturned` with a multi-selector response when more than one player matches the query. `previousRanking` is stored daily based on player activity. Subtracting `previousRanking` from the current ranking gives the player's leaderboard progression. Use `fullResult` to include full character data. The `characters` object uses the same structure as [GET /player/{username}/characters/{uuid}](api:GET/player/{username}/characters/{uuid}).

username.description: Username or UUID accepted by the player route.

fullResult.description: Presence-based flag that expands responses. Send it without a value as `?fullResult`. Using `?fullResult=true` or `?fullResult=false` is not accepted. Set true to include the flag; false omits it.

list_player_characters.description: List a player's characters. This endpoint is cached for 2 minutes in the USER cache source. See [Caching](/welcome#caching). This endpoint belongs to the PLAYER rate-limit bucket. See [Throttling and Rate Limits](/welcome#throttling-and-rate-limits). This response can be restricted by player [Access Rules](/privacy). It is recommended to request players by UUID. Username lookups can return `300 MultipleObjectsReturned` with a multi-selector response when more than one player matches the query. Returns the player's characters keyed by character UUID.

username.description: Username or UUID accepted by the player route.

get_player_character.description: Get detailed character data. This endpoint is cached for 2 minutes in the USER cache source. See [Caching](/welcome#caching). This endpoint belongs to the PLAYER rate-limit bucket. See [Throttling and Rate Limits](/welcome#throttling-and-rate-limits). Character data is subject to [Access Rules](/privacy), which can hide some stats. Check the `restrictions` object to see which access rules affected the response. You can also check the `removedStat` field to check when the character skeleton customization affect the response. It is recommended to request players by UUID. Username lookups can return `300 MultipleObjectsReturned` with a multi-selector response when more than one player matches the query. Returns the full stat payload for a single character.

username.description: Username or UUID accepted by the player route.

get_player_character_abilities.description: Get character ability map. This endpoint is cached for 10 minutes in the USER cache source. See [Caching](/welcome#caching). This endpoint belongs to the PLAYER rate-limit bucket. See [Throttling and Rate Limits](/welcome#throttling-and-rate-limits). Ability Tree is subject to [Access Rules](/privacy), which can make it unavailable. It is recommended to request players by UUID. Username lookups can return `300 MultipleObjectsReturned` with a multi-selector response when more than one player matches the query. This endpoint only lists abilities the player has enabled and performs pathfinding on the fly. To render a full in-game style ability tree, combine this response with: - [GET /ability/tree/{tree}](api:GET/ability/tree/{tree}) - [GET /ability/map/{tree}](api:GET/ability/map/{tree})

username.description: Username or UUID accepted by the player route.

get_oauth_identity.description: Get OAuth2 identity. Try it will not return usable data for this route. It depends on a live OAuth2 authentication context outside the docs. Get started with OAuth by reading [our guide](/oauth2/creating-an-application). This endpoint returns the authenticated OAuth2 application context and the linked player profiles available to the authorized user. The `profiles` object contains the player profiles that belong to the authorizing user. Access-rule bypass through OAuth2 only applies to those linked profiles when the user granted permission for it.

Prefix queries are useful when your input is a guild tag rather than a full guild name. To understand the endpoint better, try the official Wynncraft item guide while monitoring the network tab in your browser devtools. `fullResult` bypasses pagination and returns the `results` object for all objects at once. This endpoint uses the generic pagination response format. Enum values in these docs are based on the item metadata available on April 23, 2026. New item content can add or change values over time.

For range filters, an integer checks whether that value falls inside the stored recipe range. A one-value list behaves the same way. A two-value list matches any recipe whose stored range overlaps the requested range.

list_leaderboard_types.description: List leaderboard types. This endpoint is cached for 10 minutes in the SHARED cache source. See [Caching](/welcome#caching). This endpoint belongs to the LEADERBOARDS rate-limit bucket. See [Throttling and Rate Limits](/welcome#throttling-and-rate-limits). Use this list to know which leaderboard types can be requested from `GET /leaderboards/{lb_type}`.

get_leaderboard.description: Get leaderboard entries. This endpoint is cached for 10 minutes in the USER cache source. See [Caching](/welcome#caching). This endpoint belongs to the LEADERBOARDS rate-limit bucket. See [Throttling and Rate Limits](/welcome#throttling-and-rate-limits). Leaderboards update every 10 minutes for online players. Players who go offline between update intervals are flagged to update on the next interval. Use `resultLimit` with an integer below 1000 to limit the response size. The default limit is `100`. Character-based leaderboards can include `characterUuid` and `characterType`, such as profession or gamemode leaderboards. `metadata` contains variable keys depending on the leaderboard type. Some gamemode leaderboards also include top-level `characterData`, which has the same structure as player character data. Some entries also include optional rank presentation fields such as `rank`, `supportRank`, `shortenedRank`, `legacyRankColour`, and `rankBadge`. Guild season leaderboard types are dynamic and use the `guildSeason...` format returned by `GET /leaderboards/types`, such as `guildSeason32`. Raid leaderboards include a score and gambits used. Completion starts at 200, then adds +10, +20, or +30 for each gambit. `previousRanking` is stored daily depending on player activity. Subtracting `previousRanking` from the current ranking gives the player's leaderboard progression.

fetch_publisher_article.description: Fetch a published article. This endpoint is cached for 2 minutes in the SHARED cache source. See [Caching](/welcome#caching). This endpoint belongs to the SHARED rate-limit bucket. See [Throttling and Rate Limits](/welcome#throttling-and-rate-limits). Article content uses standard Markdown syntax alongside Discord-specific syntax such as timestamps. See Discord Markdown and timestamp formatting for supported syntax. Poll articles can include `question` content blocks. In those blocks, `content` can be either a plain string or a structured question object with answer options and requirements.

article_type.description: Publisher content type. Use `article` to return every published article type.

Use `article` to return every published article type in the same response. This endpoint uses the generic pagination response format.
